learning: If s-bend line-loss falls to 1.0 or below with the oval holding, keep kd at 0.6 and test whether slalom line-loss responds. If the oval oscillates above about 0.35, return kd to 0.45. If s-bend line-loss is unchanged, derivative gain is not the lever and the next test should be the line_loss mode.
notes: Geometry held at the iteration 8 best values; controller changed only in kd (0.45 to 0.6) to test whether more derivative damping reduces s-bend and slalom line-loss.
rationale: Iteration 8 (kp 3.0, kd 0.45, same geometry) is the best result at 610.7, with the oval at 20/20, s-bend at 15/20 and slalom at 0/20 with line-loss 1.9. Iteration 7 (kp 2.5, kd 0.3) scored 400.0 on the same geometry, so the controller change produced the gain. Geometry has been tested on span, footprint, forward position, wheel_track and mass, and the sharp-track gap has not moved with geometry, so I keep the Builder's geometry exactly. The next controller step is kd 0.45 to 0.6 with kp held at 3.0, changing one variable so the result is attributable. Derivative action is the lever that most recently helped s-bend, and the oval oscillation (0.22) leaves room. Slalom line-loss at 1.9 is the open problem, and the line_loss mode is kept as last_direction because changing it would confound this test. Guard: if oval steering_oscillation exceeds about 0.35 or the oval falls below 16/20, kd returns to 0.45. Expected result: s-bend line-loss at or below 1.0 with finishes at 15/20 or better, and slalom line-loss beginning to fall. This is a prediction, not a measured result.
